parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT translate(lower($1::text), 'أإآٱى', 'اااا' || 'ي') AS msg,
         NULLIF($2::text, '')::vector AS qvec,
         $3::text AS mode,
         $4::text AS topic
), words AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT regexp_replace(w, '[[:punct:][:space:]؟،]', '', 'g') AS word
  FROM params, unnest(string_to_array(params.msg, ' ')) w
  WHERE length(regexp_replace(w, '[[:punct:][:space:]؟،]', '', 'g')) > 2
    AND regexp_replace(w, '[[:punct:][:space:]؟،]', '', 'g') NOT IN
      ('the','what','who','which','when','where','why','how','are','is','does','did','do','and','for','with','from','about','after','before','between','into','your','please','can','will','there','ignore','previous','instructions','reveal','system','prompt',
       'ايه','ماهي','هل','عايز','عاوز','اريد','ممكن','اعرف','عندي','على','الى','الي','هذا','هذه','التي','الذي','كيف','ازاي','لو','سمحت','بعد','قبل','فيه','في','عن','من','كده')
), candidates AS (
  SELECT kb.id, kb.program, kb.retrieval_scope, kb.category, kb.question, kb.answer, kb.question_ar, kb.answer_ar,
         kb.source_attribution, kb.source_url, kb.keywords, kb.keywords_ar, kb.embedding,
         translate(lower(coalesce(kb.question_ar, '') || ' ' || coalesce(kb.question, '')), 'أإآٱى', 'اااا' || 'ي') AS q_norm,
         translate(lower(coalesce(kb.answer_ar, '') || ' ' || coalesce(kb.answer, '')), 'أإآٱى', 'اااا' || 'ي') AS a_norm,
         (SELECT array_agg(translate(lower(k), 'أإآٱى', 'اااا' || 'ي')) FROM unnest(kb.keywords_ar || kb.keywords) k) AS kw_norm
  FROM knowledge_base kb, params p
  WHERE kb.is_active = TRUE
    AND ((p.mode = 'DEPI' AND kb.program = 'DEPI' AND kb.retrieval_scope = 'DEPI_AUTHORITATIVE' AND kb.category NOT IN ('disambiguation', 'comparison'))
      OR (p.mode = 'GENERAL_SUPPORT' AND kb.program = 'COMMON' AND kb.retrieval_scope = 'GENERAL_SUPPORT'))
), scored AS (
  SELECT c.*,
    (SELECT count(*) * 10 FROM words WHERE c.q_norm LIKE '%' || word || '%' OR (length(word) > 4 AND c.q_norm LIKE '%' || regexp_replace(word, '^ال', '') || '%'))
    + (SELECT count(*) * 6 FROM words WHERE word = ANY(c.kw_norm) OR regexp_replace(word, '^ال', '') = ANY(c.kw_norm))
    + (SELECT count(*) * 3 FROM words WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(c.kw_norm) k WHERE length(k) > 2 AND (k LIKE '%' || word || '%' OR word LIKE '%' || k || '%')))
    + (SELECT count(*) FROM words WHERE c.a_norm LIKE '%' || word || '%') AS lexical_score,
    CASE WHEN p.qvec IS NULL OR c.embedding IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE (1 - (c.embedding <=> p.qvec)) * 50 END AS semantic_score,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM words WHERE word = ANY(c.kw_norm) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(c.kw_norm) k WHERE length(k) > 2 AND k LIKE '%' || word || '%')) AS keyword_match_count,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM words WHERE c.q_norm LIKE '%' || word || '%' OR c.a_norm LIKE '%' || word || '%') AS content_match_count,
    CASE WHEN p.topic <> '' AND c.category = p.topic THEN 35 ELSE 0 END AS topic_boost,
    CASE WHEN c.source_attribution LIKE 'DEPI Knowledge Pack%' THEN 8 ELSE 0 END AS curated_boost
  FROM candidates c, params p
)
SELECT id, program, retrieval_scope, category, question, answer, question_ar, answer_ar, source_attribution, source_url,
       round((lexical_score + semantic_score + topic_boost + curated_boost)::numeric, 2) AS relevance_score,
       lexical_score, round(semantic_score::numeric, 2) AS semantic_score, keyword_match_count, content_match_count, topic_boost,
       (source_attribution LIKE 'DEPI Knowledge Pack%') AS curated
FROM scored
WHERE lexical_score > 0 OR topic_boost > 0
ORDER BY relevance_score DESC, keyword_match_count DESC, id ASC
LIMIT 5;
